schema.description: Only these fields exist. Bounds on the text are the service's, so a bad value is a typed ``dataset_invalid`` and an over-long model id a typed ``model_unavailable``.
schema.title: CreateDatasetBody

schema.description: Only these fields exist. Ranges and id shapes are checked in the service so the reason reaches the client.
schema.title: SearchBody

schema.description: The editable fields only. A key that is absent is not a change; an explicit null clears ``description`` and ``avatar`` and is refused for the rest.
schema.title: UpdateDatasetBody

schema.description: Only ``ids`` exists. The number and shape of the ids are the service's check, so a bad one is a typed ``ids_invalid``.
schema.title: DeleteDocumentsBody

schema.description: ``doc_ids`` (the SPA) and/or ``doc_id`` (the endpoint catalogue: one id or a list); at least one, merged without duplicates. ``status``: "1" on, "0" off.

schema.description: Only these fields exist. The count and shape of the ids are the service's check, so a bad one is a typed ``ids_invalid``.
schema.title: ParseBody

schema.description: No length bound on the ids on purpose: an over-long id is a typed ``model_unavailable`` from the service, like any other bad id.
schema.title: DefaultsBody

patch.summary: Set or clear the default chat and embedding model. Only the slots named in the body change.

put.summary: Add a provider, or change the key and/or address of a configured one: the body's models are re-tested, the rest are kept.

post.summary: Models only: test and add them to an existing instance with its stored key. Credentials in the body: create that instance.
